text: Robinhood Markets, Inc. is founder-controlled through super-voting Class B shares: per its 2026 proxy statement, co-founder Vladimir Tenev (Chair and CEO) holds 44.9% of the Class B shares, 26.1% of total voting power; co-founder Baiju Bhatt holds 55.7% of Class B, 32.0% of voting power. No state shareholder is identified.
short: Robinhood Markets is founder-controlled (Tenev 26.1%, Bhatt 32.0% of voting power)

source.name: Robinhood Markets, Inc. DEF 14A 2026 Proxy Statement (SEC EDGAR)
source.note: Same beneficial-ownership table: 'Baiju Bhatt (5)(10) 3,579 * 61,076,048 55.7 32.0'. SEC requires a declared user agent for scripted access.
